title: Measurements: singular substance
focus: Use a singular partitive substance after a measure or container word: litra maitoa — a litre of milk.

exercises.explanation: The substance following this measure uses singular partitive. The measure names the amount; the next noun names what is measured. Keep maito and add -a: maito + a = maitoa.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Measurements: singular substance: form or use confused
